$comment: A whole dashboard in one file, for `node scripts/haven-seed.mjs apply`.
Copy to `config/dashboard.json` (gitignored) and describe your own.
THIS FILE IS AN EXAMPLE ONLY. A real seed file is the single most
dangerous thing in this repo to commit: it maps not just every service
URL like apps.json does, but every widget's configured endpoint too.
Every hostname below is `.invalid` on purpose. See docs/SECURITY.md.
Secrets never belong here. A `secret`-typed widget field listed in
`secretKeys` is encrypted server-side and read back only as the sentinel
`__haven_secret_set__`, which `apply` omits rather than sending. Put the
real value in the file once to set it, then remove it -- or set it in the
settings panel and never write it down here at all.
An app in the OLD dashboard's shape. `apply` accepts both and maps
this one through scripts/migrate-apps.mjs, so an existing apps.json
can be pasted in whole rather than converted first.

$comment: `secretKeys` names the config fields to route to the encrypted
credential store instead of the config blob. Set the real value here
once, apply, then delete the line -- `apply` treats an absent secret
as untouched and leaves the stored one alone.
